user.description: Connect to your AlphaESS inverter/battery on the local network.

init.description: Select the section you want to configure. Each section is saved on its own.

installation.title: Installation
installation.description: Physical specs of the roof PV, battery and inverter.

prices.title: Prices
prices.description: Supplier and network costs, VAT and the price sources. Pick an entity with day-ahead prices (e.g. from ENTSO-E, Frank Energie or Nord Pool) and add more as backups with 'Add entity': the first one that has prices is used.{missing_source_note}

data.price_entities: Price sources (in order; drag to change)

solar_forecast.title: Solar forecast
solar_forecast.description: The solar forecast locations (e.g. Forecast.Solar or Solcast): pick one of each location's sensors and add more with 'Add entity'. Locations of the same service are summed (e.g. the front and back of the roof); the service on top is used, another service only as a backup.{missing_source_note}

extra_pv.title: Additional energy sources
extra_pv.description: An energy source next to the AlphaESS, such as a second solar installation, and its optional Modbus control that switches it off at negative prices. Its power counts in the energy flow, the house load and learning the solar forecast.

data.extra_pv_modbus_hub: Extra PV: Modbus hub name (empty = disabled)

ev_charger.title: Excluded consumption
ev_charger.description: Consumers kept out of the learned house load because they're big and irregular (an EV charger, a heat pump, ...). Their power is taken off the measured house load before the load per hour is learned. Not used for control.

data.ev_charger_power_entity: EV charger: power (W) -- also in the panel's energy flow
data.ev_charger_energy_entity: EV charger: total energy (kWh) -- for the panel's daily totals

meter.title: Smart meter
meter.description: P1/smart-meter sensors for live house load and the monthly peak.

control.title: Control
control.description: Scheduler behaviour and the master switch for battery control.

data.allow_provider_control_hours: Hours where the provider may override the schedule
data.persist_daily_charge_limit: At most one full battery a day, solar and grid together (off: no daily limit; discharge for own use only)
data.control_enabled: Enable battery control (writes real commands to the inverter)

pv_total_energy_feed_to_grid.name: PV total energy fed to grid

pv_total_energy_consume_from_grid.name: PV total energy consumed from grid

daily_min_profit.name: Minimum daily profit for optimized schedule

force_charge_grid.name: Force charge from grid
force_charge_grid.description: Override the current hour's schedule to force charging from the grid, until cleared.

force_discharge.name: Force discharge
force_discharge.description: Override the current hour's schedule to force discharging the battery, until cleared.

force_charge_pv.name: Force charge from PV
force_charge_pv.description: Override the current hour's schedule to force charging from solar production only, until cleared.

force_no_charging.name: Force no charging
force_no_charging.description: Override the current hour's schedule to force no battery charging, until cleared.

clear_manual_override.name: Clear manual override
clear_manual_override.description: Remove any active manual dispatch override, reverting to the scheduler's own decision.
